$comment: Interpolation vectors per spec/04-expression-language.md#interpolation. `context` supplies every namespace a manifest step can read from. Each case's `template` is the exact ${...} string a manifest field would contain; `expected` is the exact resulting string after interpolation (and transform, where present). Every runtime must match every case byte-for-byte.

cases.description: auth namespace (only ever available in auth.apply.value/auth.token when auth.shape is oauth2_client_credentials; see spec/03-manifest-dsl.md#auth)
auth namespace composed into a larger literal template, the common apply.value shape
iso8601 transform, from an already-ISO-8601 string re-normalized to second precision and a literal Z
ctx namespace, base_url specifically (always present once an environment is resolved, even though it is never written literally in a manifest's environments block)
amount_major transform on a negative (refund/reversal) amount

additional_msisdn_et_cases.description: punctuation and spaces are stripped before normalization

whole_value_type_preservation_cases.$comment: A ${...} template that is entirely one bare (untransformed) interpolation and embeds nowhere inside a larger string — the form emit.state and emit.next_action fields use — resolves to that value's own native JSON type, not a stringified form. This only applies to a whole-value template; a template that embeds interpolation inside a larger literal string (e.g. a call.path segment) always produces a string, since the surrounding literal characters are themselves a string. See spec/01-domain-model.md#nextaction-carries-its-own-payload, where this matters for ShowTransferDetails.amount.minor_units staying an integer.

cases.description: whole-value integer interpolation stays an integer, not "10000"
whole-value integer interpolation of a zero value stays an integer 0, not a falsy-string or omitted
whole-value boolean interpolation stays a boolean, not the string "true"
the same value embedded inside a larger literal string is stringified, since the result can only be a string
